Sept scenes individuelles variees, aucun atlas ni composition a plusieurs portraits.

format.note: PNG natifs du built-in proches de 4:5; ecart relatif au ratio de 0.036 pour cent. Aucun redimensionnement, recadrage ou retouche externe.

Subject/canon: CAPITAINE SKULLY, adult male Skullz of Cryptown, NECRO navigator. Humanoid weathered skeleton with a broad worn ivory skull, normal bone hands, TWO arms and TWO legs, dignified and approachable, not menacing. A petrol-blue canvas tricorn, worn maritime green captain's coat over practical dark clothing, two leather sea boots and ONE short sword SHEATHED at the belt. No flesh decay or body damage.
Scene: he has single-handedly brought his old sailing vessel safely back to a stone quay and is making the last mooring fast. A thick hawser from his ship wraps credibly around ONE dock bollard. The old vessel is visible in the middle background as a whole readable small ship with furled sail, weathered hull and EMPTY deck, tied beside the quay.
Action/composition: full-length three-quarter view on the quay. Two boots planted wide on wet stone. One skeletal hand holds the free end of the mooring rope beside his hip after its wraps around the bollard; the other raises a restrained captain's salute to the brim of his tricorn. ONLY these two hands, no extra hand tying the rope. Skull turned toward the EMPTY ship as if respectfully saluting an absent crew. Emotion is nostalgic pride and gentle dry humor through skull tilt, shoulders and gesture, no aggressive grin; tiny quiet plum reflections in the eye sockets if needed for NECRO but no magical fire.
Lighting: last pearly daylight over water, cool marine turquoise and green contrasted with muted wine-red distant harbor roofs and one warm harbor lamp. Patient, slightly bittersweet maritime story, calm ripples. No ghosts, crowd, additional skulls, blood, gore, zombies, horror props or gratuitous horror.
